---
title: "Seasons"
---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(ggridges)
```

```{r}
mallards <- readRDS("data/mallards.rds")
```

```{r}
mallards_filtered <- mallards |>
  filter(!is.na(speed), speed <= 30)

ggplot(mallards_filtered, aes(x = speed, y = month, fill = month)) +
  geom_density_ridges(alpha = 0.8, rel_min_height = 0.01) +
  labs(x = "Speed (m/s)", y = "Month") +
  theme_ridges() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```
